method: Independent blind review (Codex as DaF/SD1 examiner, read-only, effort high, 2026-11-25): every unit was worked out from what is printed here, without keys, places of the answers, evidence or reasons, and judged for one supported answer, refutation (not silence), natural German and a believable purpose.
